arxiv-2105-10199.title: IEEE 802.11be Multi-Link Operation: When the Best Could Be to Use Only a Single Interface
arxiv-2105-10199.creator: Álvaro López-Raventós, Boris Bellalta
arxiv-2105-10199.description: Abstract The multi-link operation (MLO) is a new feature proposed to be part of the IEEE 802.11be Extremely High Throughput (EHT) amendment. Through MLO, access points and stations will be provided with the capabilities to transmit and receive data from the same traffic flow over multiple radio interfaces.

arxiv-2107-06600.title: Position reconstruction for segmented detectors Journal: Elsevier
arxiv-2107-06600.creator: A. Ebrahimi a,, F. Feindt a, E. Garutti a, M. Hajheidari a, R. Klanner a,, D. Pitzl b, J. Schwandt a, G. Steinbrück a, I. Zoi a
arxiv-2107-06600.description: Abstract The topic of the paper is the position reconstruction from signals of segmented detectors. With the help of a simple simulation, it is shown that the position reconstruction using the centre-of-gravity method is strongly biased, if the width of the charge (or e.g. light) distribution at the electrodes (or photo detectors) is less than the read-out pitch.

arxiv-2210-09413.title: Sharp regularity for singular obstacle problems
arxiv-2210-09413.creator: Damião J. Araújo, Rafayel Teymurazyan, Vardan Voskanyan
arxiv-2210-09413.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Damião J. Araújo, Rafayel Teymurazyan, Vardan Voskanyan. arxiv-2406-12047.title: Error Estimators for the Small-Biot Lumped Approximation for the Conduction Dunking Problem
arxiv-2406-12047.creator: Kento Kaneko, Claude Le Bris, Anthony T Patera
arxiv-2406-12047.description: Abstract We consider the dunking problem: a solid body at uniform temperature T i T_{\text{i}} is placed in a environment characterized by farfield temperature T ∞ T_{\infty} and spatially uniform time-independent heat transfer coefficient. We permit heterogeneous material composition: spatially dependent density, specific heat, and thermal conductivity. Mathematically, the problem is described by a heat equation with Robin boundary conditions.

arxiv-2410-20649.title: Learning Variational Inequalities from Data: Fast Generalization Rates under Strong Monotonicity
arxiv-2410-20649.creator: Eric Zhao, Tatjana Chavdarova, Michael Jordan
arxiv-2410-20649.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Eric Zhao, Tatjana Chavdarova, Michael Jordan. Variational inequalities (VIs) are a broad class of optimization problems encompassing machine learning problems ranging from standard convex minimization to more complex scenarios like min-max optimization and computing the equilibria of multi-player games.

arxiv-2501-19097.title: Analysis of the sensitivity of tumor control probability in molecular radiotherapy to uncertainties in the dose rate curves
arxiv-2501-19097.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . Background: The response to a molecular radiotherapy (MRT) treatment depends on the dose and dose rate. The reconstruction of the dose rate curves presents uncertainties that can affect the quantification of the radiobiological effect. Purpose: To investigate the sensitivity of the effectiveness (TCP) of an MRT treatment to uncertainties of the dose rate curves that may appear when reconstructing those curves from limited data samples.

arxiv-2503-22251.title: Efficient Building Roof Type Classification: A Domain-Specific Self-Supervised Approach
arxiv-2503-22251.creator: Guneet Mutreja 1, Ksenia Bittner 1
arxiv-2503-22251.description: Abstract Accurate classification of building roof types from aerial imagery is crucial for various remote sensing applications, including urban planning, disaster management, and infrastructure monitoring. However, this task is often hindered by the limited availability of labeled data for supervised learning approaches.

arxiv-2509-18155.title: Surrogate Modelling of Proton Dose with Monte Carlo Dropout Uncertainty Quantification
arxiv-2509-18155.creator: Aaron Pim, Tristan Pryer
arxiv-2509-18155.description: Abstract . Accurate proton dose calculation with Monte Carlo (MC) remains computationally demanding in workflows that require repeated evaluations, such as robust optimisation, adaptive replanning and probabilistic inference. We construct a neural surrogate that incorporates Monte Carlo dropout to provide fast, differentiable dose predictions together with voxelwise predictive uncertainty.

arxiv-2601-18905.title: The Solar Neighborhood LIV: 54 Orbits of M Dwarf Multiples within 30 Parsecs with Speckle Interferometry at SOAR Facilities: CTIO:0.9m, SOAR
arxiv-2601-18905.creator: Eliot Halley Vrijmoet, Andrei Tokovinin, Todd J. Henry, Jennifer G. Winters, Wei-Chun Jao, Elliott Horch
arxiv-2601-18905.description: Abstract We present 1066 speckle measurements of M dwarf multiples observed over 2021–2024, all taken with HRCam on the Southern Astrophysical Research 4.1 m telescope. Among these, 900 observations resolve companions in 212 pairs, with separations spanning 17 milliarcseconds to 3 . ′′ \farcs 4 and brightness differences ranging from 0 to 4.9 magnitudes in the I I filter.

arxiv-2602-12755.title: Towards reconstructing experimental sparse-view X-ray CT data with diffusion models Thanks: This work was supported by the Dutch Research Council (NWO, file number VI.Vidi.223.059)

arxiv-2602-12755.description: Abstract Diffusion-based image generators are promising priors for ill-posed inverse problems like sparse-view X-ray Computed Tomography (CT). As most studies consider synthetic data, it is not clear whether training data mismatch (“domain shift”) or forward model mismatch complicate their successful application to experimental data.

britannica-1911-dalton-in-furness.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-dalton-in-furness.description: Article 'Dalton-in-Furness' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. parliamentary division of Lancashire, England, 4 m. of Barrow-in-Furness by the Furness railway. of urban district (1901) 13,020. The church of St Mary is in the main a modern reconstruction, but retains ancient fragments and a font believed to have belonged to Furness Abbey. This fine ruin lies 3 m. south of Dalton (see Furness). St Mary’s churchyard contains the tomb of the painter George Romney, a native of the town.

britannica-1911-mora.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-mora.description: Article 'Mora' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. in Italy, in which one player endeavours to guess instantly the number of fingers held up by the other. Ancient Egyptian sculptors represent a game of this kind, and it was played by the Romans, who called it micare digitis, or finger-flashing. It is known to the Chinese and to certain tribes of the Pacific Islands.

britannica-1911-peltier-jean-charles-ath.title: Peltier, Jean Charles Athanase (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-peltier-jean-charles-ath.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-peltier-jean-charles-ath.description: Article 'Peltier, Jean Charles Athanase' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 21), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. physicist, was born at Ham (Somme) on the 22nd of February 1785. He was originally a watchmaker, but retired from business about the age of thirty and devoted himself to experimental and observational science. His papers, which are numerous, are devoted in great part to atmospheric electricity, waterspouts, cyanometry and polarization of skylight, the temperature of water in the spheroidal state, and the boiling-point at great elevations.

pmc-10559458.title: Long-term prognostic significance of gasping in out-of-hospital cardiac arrest patients undergoing extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation: a post hoc analysis of a multi-center prospective cohort study
pmc-10559458.creator: Satoshi Nara, Naofumi Bunya, Hirofumi Ohnishi, Keigo Sawamoto, Shuji Uemura, Nobuaki Kokubu, Mamoru Hase, Eichi Narimatsu, Yasufumi Asai, Yoshio Tahara, Takahiro Atsumi, Ken Nagao, Naoto Morimura, Tetsuya Sakamoto, SAVE-J Study Group
pmc-10559458.description: BackgroundGasping during resuscitation has been reported as a favorable factor for out-of-hospital cardiac arrest. We examined whether gasping during resuscitation is independently associated with favorable neurological outcomes in patients with refractory ventricular fibrillation or pulseless ventricular tachycardia (VF/pVT) undergoing extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation ECPR.

pmc-11679085.creator: Sean Clees, Spencer C. Barnes, Taylor M. Rault, Christopher L. Strand, Ronald K. Hanson
pmc-11679085.description: Distributed feedback lasers, which feature rapid wavelength tunability, are not presently available in the yellow and orange spectral regions, impeding spectroscopic studies of short-lived species that absorb light in this range. To meet this need, a rapidly tunable laser system was constructed, characterized, and demonstrated for measurements of the NH2 radical at 597.4 nm.

pmc-11859148.creator: I Š Filipčić, I Filipčić
pmc-11859148.description: IntroductionOver the last two decades, a growing volume of research has discovered a correlation between severe mental disorders (SMD) and early mortality. This is attributed to the elevated incidence of chronic physical illnesses s and multimorbidity, resulting in a reduction of life expectancy by 10-20 years.

pmc-12643058.title: Protein kinase FAM20C—when subcellular localization matters
pmc-12643058.creator: Francesca Noventa, Mauro Salvi
pmc-12643058.description: Protein kinases achieve signaling specificity through consensus sequence recognition and subcellular localization. FAM20C, an acidophilic kinase that is primarily localized to the Golgi lumen, is an example of this.
